exam: 112年公務人員升官等考試、112年關務人員升官等考試、112年交通事業鐵路人員升資考試、112年交通事業港務人員升資考試
subject: 新聞英文

essays.text:
Translate the following expressions from English into Chinese and brieflydefine the terms in English.（每小題 3 分，共 30 分）
① Trial balloons
② Media darling
③ the gutter press
④ Inforwars
⑤ TPASS
⑥ Yellow journalism Word on the wire phishing Gig economy CPI

Translate the following English into Chinese.（每小題 5 分，共 35 分）
①And budget negotiators held another budget marathon session that lastedpast midnight. There is still no agreement on the deficit reduction plan.
② Reagan was the so-called Teflon President, whose impeccable imageprotected him from scandal and charges of incompetence.
③Of course politicians will sometimes make bad decisions. At least they canbe thrown out of office unlike unaccountable central bankers.
④After a short honeymoon, the ruling coalition will begin its horse-trading,haggling over ministerial posts.
⑤Even staff as young as 40 are victims of ageism by ambitious newcomerstrying to take over their problem.
⑥The increasing sophistication of car alarms has prompted thieves to take upcarjacking, stealing cars while their owners are still in them. After collectingthe cash, the kidnapper made his escape by disappearing down the disusedrail line.Whatever the critics say, it is you the cinema-going public who decidewhether a film is a blockbuster or a turkey.

Translate the following Chinese into English.（每小題 5 分，共 35 分）
①今天開學 全臺小學還在找代理師 各地教甄重榜多 專家建議聯招
②照顧力匱乏 放寬移工仍難解
③對抗假訊息 不能循傳統模式
④暖化惡性循環 北半球野火狂燒
⑤蘇拉颱風增強 不排除花東、恆春登陸 與颱風賽跑 搶收柚子嘆缺工
⑥今夏大片 成本太貴難回本煙霾隨身飄 加國野火 紐約受災
